The $0.17953936 spend was dominated by two substantive implementation/recovery executions rather than an information-free retry loop; the second corrected the previously identified exact-expiry-boundary proof before the wall-clock budget ended.

Recovery was useful but could not close all proof gaps before the budget ended.
